title.zh-CN: 蓝色借书卡的最后一栏
title.en: The Last Line on the Blue Library Card

description.zh-CN: 海边的旧书店即将搬迁。一张在休息日留下记录的蓝色借书卡，让七濑澪与藤原律重新读起上一代人的夏天，也学着为自己的去留签名。
description.en: As a seaside bookshop prepares to move, an old blue library card leads Mio Nanase and Ritsu Fujiwara through an unfinished summer—and toward decisions they must make for themselves.
